elements.label: Season of Surging Malice
elements.description: Forces from beneath the skin of the world are leaking out in wrongful ways, and their ripples will bring suffering upon the world.

elements.label: Season of Chaotic Abnormality
elements.description: The skin of the Wake nears the limits of its existence...

elements.label: The Season of Power Ascends
elements.description: Situations always change. Times of strength will come to pass, granting me new understandings and newfound power.

elements.label: Season of Past Stirrings
elements.description: A protected consciousness should be dreamless. Yet now and then, I still dream — of times past and of possibilities beyond…

elements.label: Garrisons of Triple Knot
elements.description: A group composed of immortals who serve the Hours of the Knot, said to exist 'to guard the Bounds from threats of all new forms.' So far as their actions toward me suggest, their definition of 'threat' appears uniquely broad in its scope.

elements.label: Secret Society
elements.description: For a long time, the immortals under the Velvet have labored in shadow to conceal and contain those knowledges too dangerous for mortals. Their work has been so successful that even their very existence became nearly a secret. But now, the fall of the Calyptra has forced them to emerge from the mists, carrying out orders on behalf of their master—doing work neither elegant nor especially covert.

elements.label: Messengers of the House of the Moon
elements.description: The House of the Moon sends forth its messenger each time, and each time the messenger is different—in eyes, in flesh, in mind... And this time, the new messengers have been charged with bringing the Moon's old wounds back to the House, to fuel the great war now underway.

elements.label: Kitling Ripe
elements.description: 'Granny's never liked you anyway, and I wouldn't mind tryin' somethin' new for a change.'

elements.label: Lagiah, the Queen Unsated
elements.description: 'Poor child, come closer, closer still. Why hesitate? The fate you carry is far crueler than mine, is it not?'

elements.label: Skadi, the Demigod Huntress
elements.description: 'Abandon that foolish ambition. Your end awaits you here. Face me.'

elements.description: 'Destiny decrees thy beginning; Thou shalt shape its end.' [Developer's test tool! Where did you find this thing?]

elements.label: Brizzery, the Drifting Blade
elements.description:
In its long career, this weapon has also been called the Rebel, the Profane Sword, and the Abomination. It was, apparently, commissioned to be borne by a ranger against the hidden kings in an unknown age. So many years later, it still drifts, seeking the chosen one who can fulfill its purpose.

[A dev weapon! Where did you get this?]

elements.label: Ring of the Seven Curses
elements.description:
Throughout its long history, countless ambitious madmen have donned this ring, seeking to unleash the boundless potential hidden within — yet the ring itself bears seven dreadful curses, causing nearly every wielder to perish from the maledictions before ever fully grasping its power. It is best not to heed its temptations. 

[A developer tool! Where did you find this thing?]

elements.label: The Candle Unarrived
elements.description:
These candles symbolize the power of the Long yet to arrive for the Chandler. Past and future hold no meaning—the Chandler exists in totality, moving before the beginning unfolds.

[A developer ability! Where did you find this thing?]
